title: Opportunities for Core Domain
subtitle: Exploring Career Pathways in ECE
description: On 12th October 2026, the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, in association with the Samarthya Club, organised an interactive guidance session on “Opportunities for Core Domain” at Prerana Hall for first-year ECE and VLSI students. The session commenced with a welcome address by Dr. Dayakshini, HOD-ECE, followed by insightful sessions led by senior students covering Analog, Digital/VLSI, Embedded Systems, IT, real-world experiences, placement journeys, and preparation strategies.
tagline: Understanding the possibilities today. Building the careers of tomorrow.
highlights: Welcome address by Dr. Dayakshini, HOD-ECE
Career roadmaps in Analog, Digital/VLSI, Embedded Systems & IT
Senior student mentorship on preparation strategies & placement journeys
Interactive Q&A session clarifying doubts and domains of interest

title: SAMARTHYA 2026-27
subtitle: Inauguration & Installation of Office Bearers
description: Samarthya, the Electronics Technical Club of St. Joseph Engineering College, Mangaluru, inaugurated its activities for the academic year 2026-27 on 26th September 2026 at Kalam Auditorium. The occasion was graced by Mr. Karthik Shenoy, Co-founder of Virtual Origami Technologies, as Chief Guest, along with faculty coordinators Ms. Madhavi Gatty and Mr. Prasad S. M., Dr. Dayakshini, HOD-ECE, and Mr. Winston Pereira, President of Samarthya. The event featured the annual club report, installation of office bearers by Dr. Rohan Pinto, and presentation of the Plan of Action for 2026-27.
participants: ECE & VLSI Faculty, Office Bearers & Students
tagline: A new chapter. A renewed vision. A stronger commitment to innovation.
highlights: Chief Guest: Mr. Karthik Shenoy, Co-founder of Virtual Origami Technologies
Welcome address by Dr. Dayakshini, HOD-ECE
Installation of 2026-27 office bearers by Dr. Rohan Pinto, HOD-VLSI
Presentation of 2026-27 Plan of Action by Winston Pereira, President

title: CircuitCraft 2.0
subtitle: PCB Design Using KiCad
description: Building on the success of its first edition, Samarthya - The Electronics Technical Club of SJEC conducted CircuitCraft 2.0 from 16th - 18th March 2026, tailored for fourth-semester students. The three-day Student Development Programme (SDP) introduced 132 participants to the complete PCB development cycle, from schematic design and component selection to board layout, routing, and fabrication. Students designed, debugged, and validated a functional infrared (IR) receiver circuit.

title: CircuitCraft
subtitle: PCB Design Using KiCad
description: From 4th - 6th February 2026, Samarthya conducted CircuitCraft, a three-day hands-on Student Development Programme (SDP) on PCB design using KiCad, in collaboration with the SJEC-AICTE IDEA Lab and with support from Prodigi. The programme guided 119 sixth-semester students through the complete PCB design workflow, designing an infrared (IR) receiver circuit from start to finish.
tagline: From schematic to board learning by building

title: Electrovation 2.0
subtitle: Project Pitch & Seed Funding
description: On 24th January 2026, Samarthya conducted Electrovation 2.0 at the DSP Lab, SJEC Mangaluru. The event provided a platform for students to pitch innovative, technically feasible, and industry-relevant project ideas, bringing together 40 students across 11 competitive teams. Six projects were selected for seed-funding support: SpineAlign, Explorer, NeuroPulse, SignalX, Impedance, and Sahayog.
